summary.text: Tina Liebling is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 24B, with a tenure beginning in 2005, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Tina Liebling earned a B.A. in Spanish from the University of Minnesota, an M.S. in public health from the University of Massachusetts and a J.D. from Boston University.
Her career experience includes working as an attorney.
Ballotpedia lists Liebling's tenure in the Minnesota House as beginning in 2005, and says she assumed office in District 24B on January 3, 2023.
For 2025 and 2026 she was assigned to the Health Finance and Policy, Judiciary Finance and Civil Law (as co-chair) and Higher Education Finance and Policy committees.
